### `csvAsMap` (inline helper)

`csvAsMap dataSourceName: string`

Return the CSV as []RowMap; iterate with #each and access this.field. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/templating/templating.html

**Kind:** inline helper · **Arity:** 1 argument(s) · **Source:** Hoverfly helper

Example: `{{#each (csvAsMap 'pets')}}{{this.name}}{{/each}}`
